cases.situation: I'm organising a surprise 40th for my friend Claire and just found out the restaurant we booked for 18 people cancelled on us, 9 days before. Need to tell the group chat.
cases.reply: Bad news, everyone: Osteria Rosa cancelled our booking for the 17th this morning, they've had a flood in the kitchen. I know a few of you booked trains around it. The date stays the same; I've got holds at two other places near the station and I'll confirm one by Sunday. Still very much on.
cases.note: News in the first line, one line of why, acknowledge the cost to them, then what happens next.

cases.situation: 我是部门经理，公司今年冻结调薪，我得告诉组里的小陈，她之前一直在等这次涨薪，我也答应过帮她争取。打算先发消息约她聊。
cases.reply: 小陈，有件事想直接跟你说，不太是好消息。今年公司冻结调薪，你的涨薪这次没有批下来。我知道你一直在等，我之前也跟你说过会争取，这个结果我很抱歉。明天上午10点我们当面聊一下，我想跟你一起定一个明年上半年的具体目标，到时候我拿着它再去提。
cases.note: 消息放在前两句，不用模糊的'可能有点难'。当面聊比文字好，所以消息里先说清楚，再约时间。

cases.situation: Freelance dev. I found out the payment integration I promised a client for their Nov 1 launch can't be done with their current payment provider. Need to email the client, Rachel.
cases.reply:
Hi Rachel,
I'll get straight to it: one-tap wallet payments can't be added on your current payment provider's plan, so they won't be in the 1 November launch. I checked with the provider's support this morning and the feature is only on their enterprise tier. I know that was one of the features you wanted for the holiday rush. Two options: launch on the 1st with card payments as planned, or I add a second provider alongside your current one, which adds about a week. Happy to talk it through on a call tomorrow if that's easier.
Sam
cases.note: No three paragraphs before the news. If she's upset, don't defend; restate the two options and let her choose.

cases.situation: Borrowed my friend Nick's car for the weekend and scraped the passenger door reversing out of a parking space. My fault entirely. He only got it back from the garage last month.
cases.reply: Nick, I've got some news you won't love: I scraped the passenger door of your car reversing out of the Tesco car park this afternoon. There's a scratch about a hand's width long and a small dent, photos attached. I'm really sorry, I know you only just got it back from the garage. I'll pay for the repair in full, at whichever garage you trust, and I can drop it there myself. Call me tonight if you want to talk it through.
cases.note: When it's your fault, say it plainly with no excuse, and offer to pay before he has to ask.

cases.situation: 我和室友小周合租两年了，合同明年1月15号到期。我决定到期不续了，要搬去和男朋友住，她得自己找新室友或者换房子。她挺喜欢这套房子的。
cases.reply: 小周，有件事想早点告诉你，可能不是你想听的：1月15号合同到期后，我不打算续租了，要搬去和男朋友一起住。我知道这样你得重新找室友或者换房，挺折腾的，所以提前三个多月跟你说。找室友我可以帮你发朋友圈、一起见人，跟房东交接押金的事也我来跑。今晚回来我们当面聊聊？
cases.note: 消息放在前两句，承认对她的影响，再给具体的帮忙；大事发完消息还要当面聊。

cases.situation: Yesterday I texted my sister Hannah that I can't lend her the $3,000 for her car repair after all, because my hours at work got cut. She replied 'Great, thanks for nothing, you promised.' I don't want a fight, but I can't change my answer.
cases.reply: You're right, I did promise, and I'm sorry to go back on it. With my hours cut I can't lend the $3,000, and I know that leaves you stuck without the car. What I can do is drive you to work next week while you sort out the repair. Take whatever time you need, I'm not going anywhere.
cases.note: When they react badly, don't argue with the reaction or reopen the decision: own the broken promise, restate the news once, offer what you can and stay available.

cases.situation: I coach my town's U12 girls' soccer team. Tryouts were last weekend and 11-year-old Zoe didn't make the travel squad. She's been on the team two seasons. I need to text her mom, Karen, before the list goes out tomorrow.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, I wanted you to hear this from me before the list goes out tomorrow, and it isn't the news Zoe was hoping for. She didn't make the travel squad this season. We had 26 girls for 16 spots, and it came down to speed on the ball, which is something she can absolutely build. I know how much the team means to her after two seasons. She has a spot on the rec team, and I'd love her at our Thursday skills sessions so she's ready for spring tryouts. Happy to call tonight if you'd like to talk it through.
cases.note: Warn, give the news in line two, one honest reason framed as something she can work on, then a real path forward and a call.

cases.situation: I'm in the second year of a law degree and my parents put in $12,000 a year toward it. I've decided to leave at the end of this semester and start an electrician apprenticeship in January. I'm calling them Sunday, what do I actually say?
cases.reply: Have you both got a few minutes? I've got news you probably won't love, and I wanted to tell you myself rather than by text. I'm leaving law school at the end of this semester, in December. I've been thinking about it since the summer, and I've been offered an electrician apprenticeship with Carver Electric starting in January. I know you've put $12,000 a year into this and believed in it, and I don't take that lightly. From January I'll cover my own costs, and I'd like to walk you through the whole plan.
cases.note: Too big for a text: a call, the news by the third line, one reason, what it means for them, then the plan. Let them react before you explain more.

cases.situation: 邻居刘姐出差一周，托我喂她的猫年糕。今天下午我开门拿快递，年糕从门缝溜出去了，找了两个小时还没找到。她明天晚上才回来，我得现在告诉她。
cases.reply: 刘姐，有个不好的消息得马上告诉你：今天下午4点左右我开门拿快递，年糕从门缝跑出去了，是我没看住。我在楼道、地下车库和小区花园找了两个多小时，还没找到。已经在业主群发了照片，物业也在帮忙查监控，晚上我带着它的猫粮和小毯子再去楼下找。真的对不起，我知道你现在肯定特别着急。一有消息我马上告诉你，想打电话的话我随时在。
cases.note: 第一句就把事情说清楚，承担责任但不长篇解释，然后说已经在做什么、接下来怎么办。

cases.situation: I own one rental flat. My tenant Mrs. Alvarez has lived there six years and always pays on time. I have to sell it for family reasons. Her lease ends Jan 31, so I'm giving notice today, well over the 60 days' notice our lease requires. I'm calling her this afternoon and want to follow up in writing.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs. Alvarez,
Following our call this afternoon, I'm writing to confirm what I told you: I need to sell the flat, so I won't be renewing the lease when it ends on Sunday, January 31, 2027. This is about my family's finances and nothing to do with you; you've looked after the flat and paid on time for six years. I know six years makes it your home, and this is hard news. I'll give you a strong written reference, and if you find somewhere sooner, you can leave on two weeks' notice with no penalty. I'm happy to talk any time.
Best,
Julia Chen
cases.note: Big news goes by call first; the written note confirms the date, owns the reason and spends its words on what you'll do to help.

cases.situation: I've run Crumb & Co, a small bakery in Leeds, for seven years. The landlord is doubling the rent at renewal, so we're closing on Saturday Oct 31. I need to email our mailing list of about 900 people, a lot of them regulars.
cases.reply:
Hi everyone,
I've got news I hoped I'd never send: Crumb & Co will close for good on Saturday 31 October. Our rent is doubling at renewal, and a bakery our size can't carry that. After seven years of your Saturday queues and birthday cake orders, I know this is a loss for many of you too. We're open as normal until the 31st, every cake order already placed will be made, and loyalty cards can be used right up to closing. Come in and say hello before then, I'd love to see you.
Ruth
cases.note: With hundreds of readers, the news goes in line one and the practical questions (orders, loyalty cards) are answered before anyone has to ask.

cases.situation: 我和老公在多伦多，今年春节不回国了，三月我要论文答辩，机票也贵了一倍。我爸妈每年从十月就开始盼、开始准备年货。想先在微信上跟他们说清楚，再约视频。
cases.reply: 爸妈，有件事想早点跟你们说，免得你们白准备：今年春节我们不回去了。主要是我三月份论文答辩，那段时间走不开，机票也比平时贵了一倍多。我知道你们一直盼着过年一家人团聚，这次让你们失望了。我们打算五一放假回去住两个星期，好好陪你们。这周六晚上你们那边九点，视频聊聊好吗？
cases.note: 家人会提前准备的事，坏消息越早说越好；文字先说清楚，再约视频，给对方消化的时间。

cases.situation: I'm an account manager. Our biggest client, Norland Freight, worth $180k a year, just told me they won't renew in January because a competitor quoted them lower. I need to tell my VP, Dana, before Friday's forecast call.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, I've got bad news and wanted you to hear it from me before Friday's forecast call: Norland Freight told me this morning they won't renew in January. The reason is price; Carrow quoted them about 30% less. That takes $180k out of next year's number, and I know it lands hard on the forecast. I've asked their COO for a call next week to see whether anything short of matching price would change it, and I'll have a revised forecast to you by Thursday noon. Can we take 15 minutes tomorrow to talk it through?
cases.note: Upward bad news: the number, the reason and your next move in one message, before the meeting where it would surface.

cases.situation: We're moving from Denver to Seattle in January for my wife's new job. Our son Max is 8 and his best friend Leo lives next door. We want to tell him this weekend before he overhears it. What do I actually say?
cases.reply: Max, we've got some big news, and some of it you might not like. In January we're moving to a new house in Seattle, because Mom has a new job there. That means we won't live next door to Leo anymore, and it's okay to feel sad or cross about that. You and Leo can video call whenever you want, and we'll ask his parents if he can come and stay with us next summer. You can ask us anything about it, today or any day.
cases.note: With a child, the same shape in smaller words: warn, say it plainly, name the loss he'll care about most, and only promise what you'll actually arrange.

cases.situation: Our nanny Rosa has looked after our twins for three years. They start full-day school in January, so we won't need her after Friday Dec 18. We're telling her in person tonight and want to follow up with a text, and we'll pay her four extra weeks.
cases.reply: Rosa, thank you for hearing us out tonight. To put it in writing: with the girls starting full-day school in January, your last day with us will be Friday 18 December, and we'll pay you four extra weeks on top of your final pay. We know this is your income and it's a lot to take in, and we're sorry to bring it. We'd be glad to give you a glowing reference and pass your name to any families we know who are looking. You've been part of this family for three years, and the girls adore you.
cases.note: When the news hits someone's livelihood, give the date and the money in writing early; check your employment agreement for any required notice before you set the date.

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. Aisha and Tom got married on Saturday. One of my memory cards failed and about 60 ceremony photos, including my front-on shots of the ring exchange, are gone; recovery software got nothing back. My second shooter, Jen, has the ring exchange from the side. I'm calling them this morning and want to follow up by email with a £400 refund and a free portrait session.
cases.reply:
Hi Aisha and Tom,
Thank you for taking my call this morning. To put it in writing: one of my memory cards failed, and about 60 photos from the ceremony, including my front-on shots of the ring exchange, can't be recovered. I know those were some of the moments that mattered most to you, and I'm truly sorry. Jen, my second shooter, caught the ring exchange from the side, and those will be in your gallery. I'm refunding £400 of your fee, and I'd love to give you a free portrait session whenever suits you. I'm here any time you want to talk.
cases.note: Your mistake, their loss: call first, then put the facts, the refund and the offer in writing without a paragraph of excuses.

cases.situation: 我11月要搬去杭州，答应把现在租的房子从11月1日起转租给好朋友小林，她已经跟她的房东说了10月底退租。今天我去问房东，房东说合同不允许转租，不同意。不过房东说如果小林愿意直接跟他签新合同，月租5200可以谈。
cases.reply: 小林，有个不好的消息得马上跟你说。我今天问了房东，他不同意转租，说合同不允许，所以11月1日转给你这件事办不成了。这怪我，应该先问清楚再答应你，害你已经跟房东说了退租，真的对不起。房东说如果你愿意直接跟他签新合同，月租5200可以谈；你有兴趣的话我今晚就把他的联系方式发你，不合适的话我陪你一起找房。你晚上方便的话，我给你打个电话？
cases.note: 先说结论，再认自己的责任；把房东给的另一条路和自己能出的力一起摆出来，最后约电话。

cases.situation: I'm renovating Mrs. Greene's bathroom. Today we lifted the old tub and found rot in two floor joists underneath, which has to be fixed before we can tile. It adds $2,400 and moves the finish from Friday Oct 9 to Wednesday Oct 14. I'm texting her photos now and would rather talk it through on a call before we go ahead.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Greene, some news on the bathroom you won't love. When we lifted the old tub today we found rot in two of the floor joists underneath, and they have to be replaced before we can tile; photos attached. That adds $2,400 and moves the finish from Friday 9 October to Wednesday 14 October. I know that's more money and more days of disruption. Could I call you this evening to go through it before we do any of the extra work?
cases.note: Surprise costs: photos, the number and the new date in one message, then a call before any extra work starts.
